title: The Tow Hook
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, the loading hook turned into a weapon instead of a tool.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now lash a loading hook to a shaft with tow cord, cargo tool turned into something meaner.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking tow cord, for anyone who would rather buy than pull it off what's hauling cargo out there.

items.name: Tow hook
items.examine: A loading hook lashed to a shaft with tow cord. Still built for cargo, not for this.
